    feed_id: string!
    amount_kg: integer!
- clean_pool — Clean a pool.
    pool_id: string!
- transfer_animal — Start an animal transfer.
    animal_id: string!
    destination: string!
- report_to_veterinary — Report an issue to the veterinary office.
    subject: string!
    detail: string!
- get_animal_status — Read the current status of an animal.
